title: Hello Sword
author: Andrea Rezzonico
description: You didn't have the willpower to go out this morning: today is one of the hottest days of the month, the air is so damp it seems viscous and the bed appears to you as a valid alternative to anything. Despite all that, here you are on the street, an easy target for the sun. And who's guilty of it? Your friend Julius - damn it all! - asked you to deliver a message... Right now, the only thing you can do is read the note Julius left, deliver the message and then head back home...
